items.title: Oracle Stock Jumps on Expanded Google Gemini Partnership, Strong Microsoft Cloud Results
items.summary: Beaten-down Oracle stock got a big lift Thursday following news that it will expand a partnership with Google parent Alphabet.  Strong results from enterprise tech rival Microsoft are also likely providing a boost.  An expanded partnership will bring Google's Gemini models to Oracle's portfolio of enterprise applications, the companies announced in a joint press release.
